QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] An Elven Surprise
QuestInfo.0: You brought Ellin all 50 Moss Snail Shells. It's time to get some fruit from her.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the fresh Oranges to Yuris.\nYuris's pregnant, and her child's name will be Kyrin...\nWait a minute! Could that be the same Kyrin?

0.0: Here, take these. You don't want to know how I get them out here. And be sure to give them to Yuris!

yes.0: Oh, and please...tell Yuris to mind her own business. We're not friends like that.

no.0: What, now you're busy all of a sudden? I thought Yuris needed this fruit!

1.0: Oh man...I'm so close to getting this Airship off the ground!\r\n#L0##bHey! I brought you some sweet and sour fruit.#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, yeah, that... I remember. I don't feel like eating it now, but I'll save it. Might want it later. Thanks anyway.\r\n#L0##b(What?! She wanted that so bad! What's her deal...?) Where will you go once the Airship is ready? #l\n#k
1.2: Who cares? Away. More importantly, this ship needs a new name. Got any ideas?\r\n#L0##bHmm... Falcon? Enterprise? Pearl?#l\n#k
1.3: Ha! Those are terrible! I'm going to go with my original idea. We'll call her the "Kyrin". Isn't that pretty? When my daughter is born, I'm going to name her Kyrin. Oh...don't tell anyone I'm pregnant, though.

yes.0: Anyway, thanks for the fruit. I should finish up the Airship. Oh, and go see #eAthena Pierce#n in the Camp Conference Room. She was looking for you.

npc.0: Take these to Yuris now. Don't lose 'em!

item.0: I want it! Want it so bad! Something juicy, sour, and sweet!

lost.0: You lost the fruit I gave you, didn't you? I told you, it's really hard to get! You're lucky I found it. Take this to Yuris. And DON'T LOSE IT!!
